objective: Advance only those machine-discovered hidden patterns that survived a frozen internal held-out source-family panel, a preregistered source-classification rubric, broad-family dependency collapse, complete negative/not-applicable retention, and exact destructive graph/status rewiring.

discovery_basis.anti_circularity: Connection-family artifacts remain zero-weight as independent evidence for Connection discoveries.
discovery_basis.snapshot_scope_rule: ALL_JSON always refers to an explicitly named frozen commit; no timeless repository-wide coverage claim is allowed.

promoted_patterns.name: NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDING_LADDER
promoted_patterns.core: Evidence at layer N can license testing layer N+1 but is not automatically evidence for layer N+1.
strong_examples: Fallout MS08: real object / true statement / possession of evidence / legitimate authority are distinct properties.
Fundamentum: producer-local result / CI / semantic admission / root theorem are non-equivalent claim states.
Linear A: local relation / cross-partition replication / transcription / independent implementation / decipherment are distinct promotion layers.
Genesis temporal trust: signature validity / historical validity / current trust / semantic truth or recovery guarantee are distinct evidence types.

promoted_patterns.name: AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_STATE
promoted_patterns.core: When available evidence does not discriminate a unique binding, preserve null/candidate-set/unresolved state until new discriminating evidence arrives; do not manufacture a singleton.
strong_examples: Mothership crystals: multiple functions remain live and UNKNOWN must remain unknown until role-bound use evidence exists.
Linear A: non-evaluability is distinct from replication failure.
Cosmology/UAP: conflicting analyses remain contested until preregistered controls adjudicate them.
Genesis recovery: uncertain compromise time widens the contested interval rather than inventing a precise safe boundary.

promoted_patterns.name: FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENERALIZES_BEYOND_VISUAL_SCORING
promoted_patterns.core: For an ordered prerequisite chain, preserve the earliest unsatisfied boundary because a single aggregate score loses where the chain first became inadmissible.

retained_nonpromoted_patterns.name: MEASURE_OR_EXTRACT_BEFORE_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT
retained_nonpromoted_patterns.reason: Closest Connection predecessors already captured identity-before-interpretation and blindness/control separation.

retained_nonpromoted_patterns.name: IRREVERSIBILITY_WEIGHTED_GATE_STRENGTH
retained_nonpromoted_patterns.reason: Cross-domain architectural analogy exists but has not received the same held-out destructive validation.

meta_insight.name: THE_REGISTRY_IS_BECOMING_A_GRAPH_OF_EVIDENCE_TYPES_NOT_ONLY_A_GRAPH_OF_TOPICS
meta_insight.statement: The strongest surviving hidden recurrences concern transformations between evidence states—identity, binding, ambiguity, admission and failure localization—rather than shared subject matter.
meta_insight.boundary: This remains an internal observation over a repository with substantial common authorship.

next_gate.name: REPOSITORY_EXTERNAL_BLIND_TRANSPORT

Perform blind mapping, retain contradictions and not-applicable cases, then destroy the proposed relation through matched rewiring.
